scientific_integrity.evidence: Analytic Voronoi-cell variance decomposition, comparison with explicit midpoint codebooks, and exact rational checks.
scientific_integrity.unproved_scope: Global classification of all three-means layouts or exact sharp critical gap.

scientific_limitations: Only a support-gap-support layout among three optimal centers is ruled out.
The separate two-center problem, same-support neighboring centers and unequal segment lengths are not classified.
The sufficient separation threshold \(G\ge L/\sqrt2\) is not claimed sharp.
title: A separation barrier for gap-bridging three-means of uniform mixtures
